channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Two UAE state vessels targeted in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Two UAE state oil vessels attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, prompting Abu Dhabi to condemn Iranian strikes in the region.

item.title: Report: US military has lost roughly 45 attack and reconnaissance drones since war began
item.description: The Washington Post reports that the US military has lost approximately 45 advanced MQ-9 Reaper drones out of the 185 it possessed prior to the outbreak of the war.

item.title: Vance: US aims to stabilize oil prices and stop Iranian nuke capability
item.description: VP JD Vance tells Fox News that US strategy in Iran centers on stabilizing energy costs and barring Tehran from developing nuclear weapons.

item.title: 'The Reservists' attack Smotrich: You chose to represent draft evaders and forgot those who serve
item.description:
The Zionist Home - The Reservists party slammed Bezalel Smotrich's "Reservists Plan," arguing that reducing the number of reserve duty days fails to address the underlying soldier shortage.
"You chose to represent draft evaders and forgot those who serve - the serving public will not forget this," the party stated.

item.title: Rock-throwing attack near Kiryat Arba leaves five lightly injured
item.description: Club-wielding terrorists ambush a resident walking in the area. Security forces rushed to the scene come under a barrage of rocks, leaving five people with minor injuries.

item.title: Report: Kushner planning Israel visit to advance Trump Gaza plan
item.description: Jared Kushner is set to travel to Israel next week to coordinate the White House's Gaza transition plan with Prime Minister Netanyahu, sources tell Axios.

item.title: Gaza lookouts warn of October 7 echoes as Hamas tests IDF response
item.description: IDF lookouts warn Hamas terrorists are approaching Gaza's yellow line daily and say troops face delays obtaining authorization to open fire.

item.title: Israeli aid delegation departs for Colombia after earthquake
item.description: The joint humanitarian delegation of the IDF, the Ministry of Defense and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, “Alliance of Brothers", will depart tonight for Columbia following the earthquake.

item.title: Five injured in rock attack near Kiryat Arba
item.description: Five people were lightly injured in a rock attack in the Orot Netanel neighborhood in the area of Hilltop 26 near Kiryat Arba. According to Judea and Samaria Rescuers Without Borders, two civilians and three members of the security forces were injured.

item.title: Huckabee defends Jews of Judea and Samaria: 'Unsettlers' are the problem
item.description: US Ambassador Mike Huckabee defended Judea and Samaria communities while condemning Israelis involved in the Qusra incident as a harmful minority.

item.title: US Antisemitism Envoy praises Saudi efforts to reform school curricula
item.description: Ambassador Rabbi Yehuda Kaploun welcomed Saudi Arabia's efforts to address concerning material in school textbooks, calling for further steps toward peace and coexistence in the spirit of the Abraham Accords.

item.title: 'We can do it again': Kushner marks six years of Abraham Accords
item.description: Jared Kushner and Israeli President Isaac Herzog marked six years of the Abraham Accords, urging expanded regional cooperation, security and prosperity.

item.title: The land-for-peace travesty
item.description: Giving enemies, who are sworn to our destruction, parts of Israel is equally emphatically not the Jewish way of relating to them.

item.title: Do we need a king?
item.description: As Jews, our national mission requires that certain individual preferences be sacrificed for the sake of societal good.

item.title: IDF confirms: Terrorist who infiltrated Israel on 10/7 eliminated
item.description: IDF confirms that it eliminated Jamal Mahmoud Abu Kamil, a commander in the Hamas terrorist organization who infiltrated Israeli territory during the October 7th Massacre, in an IDF strike on his car.

item.title: Smotrich launches plan: Fewer reserve duty days
item.description: Minister Bezalel Smotrich launched the “Reservists Home" plan, centered on a goal of reducing reserve service to 30 days a year as early as 2027.

item.title: Nearly a week with no leads: Israeli mother, daughter may have left austria
item.description: Nearly a week after Mali and Liel Yahalomi vanished in Vienna, Israeli police are pursuing several possibilities as Austria considers whether they left the country.

item.title: The catalyst for Jew-hatred
item.description: “Islamophobia" is a crock of drivel as a real phenomenon, but it is employed as armor against any criticism of even the most radical Muslims, and in turn is used as a weapon that has intimidated many Americans into acquiescence in the transformation of their country. Op-ed.

item.title: Yahalomi family breaks silence on rumors surrounding Vienna disappearance
item.description: The Yahalomi family urged authorities to keep every avenue open in the search for Mali and Liel, while rejecting unverified reports about their disappearance.

item.title: Security concerns force El Al to cancel direct Hanoi flights
item.description: El Al canceled its planned direct Hanoi route after Israeli security officials declined to approve flights with Israeli aircraft and crews.

item.title: Hegseth: 'We have capability, will, & patience to maintain blockade indefinitely'
item.description: US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth tells Congress the blockade against Iran will be maintained 'as long as needed.'

item.title: Rare August rain and thunderstorms: Surprising weekend Israel weather forcast
item.description: Israel will get relief from the August heat as temperatures are expected to drop over the weekend, with a chance of rainfall in parts of the country.

item.title: 'Settlers' returning to their Biblical status
item.description: The word "settlers" is often used as a pejorative, but a study of the Torah, the Sages, and the words of our Rabbis reveals the central place of "inheritance" in the Jewish story.

item.title: IDF locates numerous weapons in the Security Zone in southern Lebanon
item.description:
Yesterday (Wednesday), during an operation in the area of Mrah el Aaqbe, IDF soldiers of the 55th Brigade located and dismantled a booby-trapped structure belonging to the Hezbollah terrorist organization.
Additionally, the soldiers located RPG rockets and additional weapons.
"The IDF will not allow the Hezbollah terrorist organization to harm Israeli civilians and its soldiers, and will continue to operate in order to remove threats in accordance with the ceasefire agreement," the military said.

item.title: Netanyahu ordered to remove video after petition over minors
item.description: Election Committee Chairman Justice Noam Sohlberg ordered Netanyahu's video removed after a petition alleged it improperly featured children in a campaign.

item.title: “No concern of embezzlement" | Bank issues message to customers following rumors
item.description: Bank of Jerusalem sent a clarification to customers following rumors surrounding the disappearance of employee Mali Yahalomi.

item.title: Footage from the scene: Gaza District Police Chief eliminated in strike on vehicle
item.description: Commander of the Gaza District Police, Jamal Mahmoud Abu Kamil, was eliminated in an IDF strike on his car. Earlier in the day, the IDF eliminated a Hamas commander in Khan Yunis.

item.title: Anti-Zionists' fantasies create reality in which Jewish children are under threat
item.description: The fictional "Gazan children starving" scenario was never real. It was meant to destroy empathy for Jewish children - schoolchildren, toddlers, and babies. Opinion.

item.description: Austrian report: Mossad joins search for two missing Israelis

item.title: Survey: Majority of Australians fear for religious safety after Bondi
item.description: A new CAM survey finds 52% of Australians feel less confident people of all faiths can live safely after the Bondi Beach Hanukkah massacre.
